posts.en:
dsh-plugin-project-management is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A DeepSeek Harness plugin that interviews the user about a project, generates a project timeline / Gantt chart, and exports it as Word or Excel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ee6fb53f9c92838d95c6.html
